title: Rehearsal Dinners
metaTitle: Rehearsal Dinner Venue in Mission Beach, San Diego
description: Host a rehearsal dinner at Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach, San Diego with seated dining, cocktails and private event space at 3704 Mission Blvd.
cardDesc: A relaxed Mission Beach rehearsal dinner setting with seated dining, cocktails and private-event options steps from the Pacific.
body: Host the night-before celebration in Miss B's tropical dining room or a larger indoor-outdoor configuration in Mission Beach, San Diego.
Seated rehearsal dinners can be planned for groups up to 60 with food, cocktail and service options coordinated around the event.
